items.description: Use it to teach 'Heal' spell to an element of the party

items.name: Wedding Ring
items.description: A cheap silver ring, maybe important to someone.

items.name: Poisoned Apple
items.description: This lethal apple can kill whoever eats it

items.name: Silver Bar
items.description: A silver ingot crafted by slaves

items.description: A sacred candle used in resurrection rituals.

actors.name: Domestic Goblin
dialogue: My master is asleep in his tomb... EhhEh. What?
You have to slay him to free the city from his sins? It sounds medieval to me, i like it...
But i don't know, eheh... Eheh  Eh... you know what? I'm sick of these putrid corpses.
You can awake The Master spraying Holy Water on his tomb, but i bet you already knew that eheh...

actors.name: Cleaner Tomb
actors.dialogue: [The air is sick around here...]

interactions.text: [The water is eroding gold, unveiling a smelly man, AND THEN HE ATTACKS!]

actors.name: Headless animated mannequin
actors.dialogue: [He's running around, looking for its head. He moves around his arms trying to reach for it but he can feel nothing. He seems desperate.]

text: [you put the Doll Face on the top of the mannequin's neck and it calms him down]
[Suddenly, his mouth opens:]
Thanks for your help, kind traveller.
For i am pleased by kindness and i admire your courage i gift you a powerful spell.
May this help you find greatness.
[The mannequin leaves the cave]

actors.name: Lesser Demon
actors.dialogue: hello world

actors.name: Unsettling statue
actors.dialogue: [the air is sick around here] ...

actors.name: Priest
dialogue: Thanks for slaying those demons.
I think it's that statue's fault, it seems possessed...
Pouring holy water on top of it should help cleanse that devil,
but beware of the consequences!

actors.name: Cursed Closet

interactions.text: [The teaspoon started smoking and turned into a ghost!]

actors.dialogue: [why is this wardobe eating itself... And how?]

actors.name: Troubled Merchant
dialogue: Uff... That's too tough! Another poltergeist!
I don't have enough money to call the priest once again!
I bet a little bit of holy water could help, but i'm too scared to try!

actors.name: Innkeeper
actors.dialogue: We got some comfortable beds to get you through the night.

actors.name: Hairy Thomas
actors.dialogue: [he's drunk as fuck] Hic! You seem ready for a fight... Come taste my sword! Hic!

actors.name: Skinny beggar
dialogue: I'm ill... Could you give me a little potion?

text: [He drinks the potion and seems to feel better]
Thanks, man! I can only give you this. It will come handy, trust me.
Give it to someone who really need it.
[He seems to feel better]
Thanks, man! I can only give you this. It will come handy, trust me.
Give it to someone who really need it.

actors.name: thielf
actors.dialogue: hello world

actors.name: Scary man
dialogue: Come on baby... UH!
Leave us alone, dude!

actors.name: Woman
dialogue: Please no! Don't touch me! No!
Sir! Sir please help me! Sir!!

actors.name: Very fast woman
dialogue: Come on man, make it quick: buy or leave, buy or leave

actors.name: Hooker
dialogue: I can make you 'rest'... For money.

actors.name: Granny
actors.dialogue: I bet you are tired, why don't you rest?

actors.name: Unsettling merchant
actors.dialogue: [he lowkey looks like a rat] Eh! You here to buy? You here to sell? Make it quick!

actors.name: Street Merchant
actors.dialogue: That guy over there stole my Wedding Ring... Could you take it back?

interactions.text: Thanks so much... Now my wife will not leave me!

actors.name: Skid Column
actors.dialogue: What?! I stole nothing from that man!

actors.name: Goblin
actors.dialogue: hello world

actors.name: Shining Chest
actors.dialogue: [Bad luck... It's locked!]

interactions.text: The trapdoor opened making a terrible noise...

actors.name: The Witch
actors.dialogue: Who are you? The Dragon? Good luck with that EHEHEHHE!

actors.name: Merchant Thief
dialogue: Be ready to hear from us, you'll receive some quests soon.
You can shop here, by the way!
Feel free to serve yourself.

text: [sounds uninterested] New face, uh?
Congratulations, you're welcome to the Thives Guild!
What? You didn't know about us? I mean, who cares!
You reached the Dark Sewers, and that's enough.
Getting here is the entrance test.
Be ready to hear from us, you'll receive some quests soon.

actors.name: Assessor n.1

interactions.text: [Assessor n.1]: Oh no... IS THAT... MMMMMAAAAAARGH!!! [The assessor suddenly grows bigger canines and attacks the party!]

dialogue: [he's pale and he's scratching himself]
Grrnn... This light is killing me!

actors.name: The Mayor
dialogue: This city is truly doomed... The assessor went crazy too...
Please help him!

actors.name: Assessor n.2
dialogue: [looking at Assessor 1, scared]...
I don't know what he's having, but i don't want that.

actors.name: Gladiator
actors.dialogue: hello world

actors.name: Arena Master
actors.dialogue: Very good fight my brother!! Wait, what?? Who are you?? How did you beat them??

actors.name: Fan
actors.dialogue: I should have bet on you!

actors.name: Sharp dressed prisoner
dialogue: Hey you, i am a thieves guild member like you!
Help me get out of here, i need a wax key or something like that...

interactions.text: Thanks man, i owe you one!
Thanks man, i owe you one!

actors.name: Imperial guard
actors.dialogue: What are you looking at, scum?

actors.name: The Real Heir
dialogue: I owe you my deepest gratitude for slaying those bandits, mercenaries hired by the King.
As the Real Heir to the Throne, Laura Marie, I will reward you with the sword of my knights.
That makes you, in fact, a Knight of the New Reign.
The Truth will be revealed soon, and the King will be dethroned.
We will now travel to the Fortune Teller Tent to prove my royal bloodline once for all.
Join us, if you want to make history!

actors.name: Laura Marie
actors.dialogue: That Globe will unveil the Truth.

actors.name: Ecclesius
dialogue: I am Ecclesius, The Real Heir's Guard.
The brightest future shines among us.

actors.name: Fortune Teller
dialogue: SSSSHHH... I'm concentrating!!

actors.name: Crystal Globe
actors.dialogue: [There's a Crystal Globe on a table covered with red linen.]

actors.name: Laura Marie
dialogue: I'm the Real Heir, Laura Marie, and I'm here to claim The Throne!
Do not oppose resistance upon us and surrend now, or face my Knights!

actors.name: The King
dialogue: You really want to take my throne??
Beware... That's some risky business.

actors.name: Aristocrat
dialogue: I knew I had to stay home today... Could you give this to my family if i die?

text: I knew I had to stay home today... Could you give this to my family if i die?

actors.name: Ecclesius
dialogue: How you dare betraying our last spark of hope? You will pay for this!

actors.name: Laura Marie
dialogue: We finally meet again... I can't stand your betrayal.
By the powers my royal bloodline gave me, I sentence you to death!

actors.name: Thief
dialogue: Stop that nonsense, filthy spy!
Give back what you own to The Guild and you'll be fine.

text: Thanks for helping, fellow thief.

actors.name: Sharp dressed man
dialogue: Oh!! It's you! I'm in danger, this man is accusing me!
You can trust me... Please kill this man! I can pay you well!.

text: You saved me!! Your reward will be priceless, i swear!
But i have to go now... Eheh, see you in another life!!

actors.name: Thieves Guild Master
dialogue: You filthy traitor... You killed our brother!
Thought you could get away with it? I know everything about my associates...
But i didn't think you were so stupid to come back here.
You will pay for this with your blood.

actors.name: Far Land Emissary
dialogue: Well, well, well... We finally found you.
Why were we looking for you? Who are we?
And WHY am i talking in plural? Well...
You happened to kill one of my ears, my tongues...
...One of my spies, if you want to me to be clear.
So... What about i kill you now?.

actors.name: Frank the Mad Scientist
dialogue: Welcome, welcome! Don't mind the smell...
This is my greatest creation — a Golem, built from pieces of my beloved ones.
I believe that with the right ritual candle, it could gain a soul.
Here, take this Revive Candle — use it on my Golem!
What could possibly go wrong...?

interactions.text: [Frank hands you a Revive Candle with a manic grin]

actors.name: Experiment Golem
actors.dialogue: [The Golem lies motionless on the laboratory slab...]

interactions.text: [The candle flame flickers wildly. The Golem's eyes snap open — and then it roars!]

actors.name: Crouching Hunchback
actors.dialogue: [Ssshhh!] The performance is about to begin! BEHOLD — THE PHANTOM!

actors.name: Dark Adept
dialogue: Ah, a visitor. I am in the middle of a sacred initiation ritual.
I must revive this rabbit as proof of my devotion, but my powers are not enough...
If you have Holy Water, use it on the rabbit. I will reward you generously.

actors.name: Dead Rabbit
actors.dialogue: [A small grey rabbit lies still upon a stone altar. Its fur is cold to the touch.]

interactions.text: [You pour holy water over the rabbit. It twitches... and its eyes open! The Adept cheers!]

actors.name: Phantom of the Opera
actors.dialogue: THE MUSIC OF THE NIGHT!

locations.name: The House Of The Rising Sun
